Card order

The values you compare (answer choices in Learn, cards in Rank, protons in Most acidic) are at least 5 pKa units apart on Easy and 1 on Hard. Mixed questions are multiple choice until a card is familiar, then typed. A card is mastered after two correct answers in a row; progress is saved in this browser.

Sets

Molecules

Values marked ≈ are estimates from a simple model compound; the others are measured. Each molecule uses one scale: water, unless DMSO is shown.

Space flips the card. The arrow keys move between cards.

Click a card to open it as a flashcard.

Edit your cards

One card per line: name | formula | pKa | note. Formula and note are optional, so name | pKa works too. Write 14.0 / 15.7 to accept more than one value. To bring in a Quizlet set, choose Export on Quizlet, keep “Tab” between term and definition and “New line” between rows, and paste it here. Cards named like a built-in molecule get its structure.
